
## Setup & Shared Data

```{r shared-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
# Input files

  "IFSp",   "Cognitive", 11,  "p9-46v", "Cognitive", 12,
  "IP1",    "Cognitive", 13,  "TPOJ1",  "Cognitive", 14,
  "55b",    "Affective", 15,  "PI",     "Affective", 16,
  "FOP5",   "Affective", 17
)

# Parcel order for 3-group figs (real_vs_rest subset)
PARCEL_ORDER_3GRP <- tribble(
  ~parcel_name, ~group_label, ~overlap_pos,

)

FONT_PT    <- 10
DODGE_WIDTH <- 0.8

# Load parcellation info
parcel_info <- read.delim(PARCEL_TSV, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rename(parcel_num = `Parcel.Number`) %>%
  select(parcel_num, parcel_name = parcel, section, section_num) %>%
  mutate(section = gsub("_", " ", section))

# Load CSVs
df_ttest <- read.csv(TTEST_CSV, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df_anova <- read.csv(ANOVA_CSV, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

## Helper Functions

```{r helpers}
# Significance stars from FDR p-value
assign_stars <- function(p_fdr, significant_fdr) {
  case_when(
    !significant_fdr  ~ "",
    is.na(p_fdr)      ~ "*",
    p_fdr < 0.001     ~ "***",
    p_fdr < 0.01      ~ "**",
    TRUE              ~ "*"
  )
}

# Build sig_long (2 groups: Native vs L2)
prep_2group <- function(df, contrast_name, parcel_order) {
  sig_df <- df %>%
    filter(contrast == contrast_name,
           significant_fdr %in% c(TRUE, "True", "TRUE")) %>%
    left_join(parcel_info, by = c("parcel" = "parcel_num"))

  sig_long <- sig_df %>%
    select(parcel_name, t_stat, p_fdr, significant_fdr,
           native_mean, native_se, l2_mean, l2_se) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(native_mean, native_se, l2_mean, l2_se),
                 names_to = c("Group", ".value"),
                 names_pattern = "(native|l2)_(mean|se)") %>%
    mutate(Group = recode(Group, native = "Native speakers", l2 = "L2 learners"),
           Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Native speakers", "L2 learners"))) %>%
    left_join(parcel_order, by = "parcel_name") %>%
    mutate(group_label = factor(group_label, levels = c("Auditory", "Cognitive", "Affective")),
           parcel_name  = reorder(parcel_name, pos))

  list(sig_df = sig_df, sig_long = sig_long)
}

# Build sig_long (3 groups: Native vs L2-High vs L2-Low)
prep_3group <- function(df, contrast_name, overlap_order) {
  sig_df <- df %>%
    filter(contrast == contrast_name,
           significant_fdr %in% c(TRUE, "True", "TRUE")) %>%
    left_join(parcel_info, by = c("parcel" = "parcel_num"))

  sig_long <- sig_df %>%
    select(parcel_name, section, section_num, f_stat, p_fdr, significant_fdr,
           native_mean, native_se, l2_high_mean, l2_high_se,
           l2_low_mean, l2_low_se) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(native_mean, native_se, l2_high_mean, l2_high_se,
                          l2_low_mean, l2_low_se),
                 names_to = c("Group", ".value"),
                 names_pattern = "(native|l2_high|l2_low)_(mean|se)") %>%
    mutate(Group = recode(Group,
                          native   = "Native speakers",
                          l2_high  = "Higher proficiency learners",
                          l2_low   = "Lower proficiency learners"),
           Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Native speakers",
                                            "Higher proficiency learners",
                                            "Lower proficiency learners"))) %>%
    left_join(overlap_order, by = "parcel_name") %>%
    mutate(is_overlap = !is.na(group_label)) %>%
    arrange(desc(is_overlap), overlap_pos, section_num, desc(abs(f_stat))) %>%
    mutate(parcel_name = factor(parcel_name, levels = unique(parcel_name)),
           group_label = factor(group_label, levels = c("Auditory", "Cognitive", "Affective")))

  parcel_pos <- tibble(parcel_name = levels(sig_long$parcel_name),
                       pos = seq_along(levels(sig_long$parcel_name)))
  sig_long <- sig_long %>% left_join(parcel_pos, by = "parcel_name")

  list(sig_df = sig_df, sig_long = sig_long, parcel_pos = parcel_pos)
}

# ROI bar plot (shared layout for all figures)
roi_barplot <- function(sig_long, sig_df, parcel_label_df, bracket_df,
                        y_label, group_colors,
                        plot_ymin = -2, star_col = "y_star",
                        use_cap_brackets = FALSE) {

  plot_ymax  <- max(c(sig_long$mean + sig_long$se,
                      sig_long[[star_col]]), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
  plot_range <- plot_ymax - plot_ymin

  parcel_label_y <- plot_ymin - 0.06 * plot_range
  bracket_y      <- plot_ymin - 0.24 * plot_range
  tick_len       <- 0.03 * plot_range
  label_y        <- bracket_y - 0.06 * plot_range

  star_lookup <- sig_df %>%
    mutate(parcel_name = as.character(parcel_name),
           p_fdr = as.numeric(p_fdr),
           significant_fdr = significant_fdr %in% c(TRUE, "True", "TRUE")) %>%
    select(parcel_name, p_fdr, significant_fdr)

  star_df <- sig_long %>%
    mutate(parcel_name_chr = as.character(parcel_name)) %>%
    group_by(parcel_name, parcel_name_chr, group_label, pos) %>%
    summarise(y_top = max(mean + se, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(star_lookup, by = c("parcel_name_chr" = "parcel_name")) %>%
    mutate(stars = assign_stars(p_fdr, significant_fdr)) %>%
    filter(stars != "")

  ggplot(sig_long, aes(x = pos, y = mean, fill = Group)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = DODGE_WIDTH), width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
                  position = position_dodge(width = DODGE_WIDTH), width = 0.25) +
    geom_text(data = star_df,
              aes(x = pos, y = y_top, label = stars),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 0, nudge_y = 0.05, size = FONT_PT / .pt) +
    geom_text(data = parcel_label_df,
              aes(x = pos, y = parcel_label_y, label = parcel_name),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = FONT_PT / .pt, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1) +
    geom_segment(data = bracket_df,
                 aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = bracket_y, yend = bracket_y),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(data = bracket_df,
                 aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin, y = bracket_y, yend = bracket_y + tick_len),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(data = bracket_df,
                 aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax, y = bracket_y, yend = bracket_y + tick_len),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(data = bracket_df,
              aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = label_y, label = group_label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, fontface = "bold", size = FONT_PT / .pt, vjust = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off", ylim = c(plot_ymin, plot_ymax)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = FONT_PT) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 70, l = 10))

}
```

## Figure 2b: Real vs Fake — Native vs L2

```{r fig2b}
out <- prep_2group(df_ttest, "real_vs_fake", PARCEL_ORDER)
sig_long <- out$sig_long
sig_df   <- out$sig_df

bracket_df <- PARCEL_ORDER %>%
  filter(parcel_name %in% unique(sig_long$parcel_name)) %>%
  group_by(group_label) %>%
  summarise(xmin = min(pos) - 0.4, xmax = max(pos) + 0.4, .groups = "drop")

roi_barplot(sig_long, sig_df,
            parcel_label_df = PARCEL_ORDER %>% filter(parcel_name %in% unique(sig_long$parcel_name)),
            bracket_df = bracket_df,
            y_label = bquote(paste("Average "* italic(t) * " (real vs. pseudo)")),
            group_colors = GROUP_COLORS_2)
```

## Figure 4: Real vs Rest & Fake vs Rest — Native vs L2

```{r fig4}
df_named <- df_ttest %>% left_join(parcel_info, by = c("parcel" = "parcel_num")) %>%
  mutate(section = ifelse(section == "Emotion", "Affective", section))

sig_real  <- df_named %>% filter(contrast == "real_vs_rest", significant_fdr %in% c(TRUE,"True","TRUE")) %>% pull(parcel_name)
sig_fake  <- df_named %>% filter(contrast == "fake_vs_rest", significant_fdr %in% c(TRUE,"True","TRUE")) %>% pull(parcel_name)
union_parcels <- union(sig_real, sig_fake)

parcel_order_4 <- tibble(parcel_name = union_parcels) %>%
  left_join(PARCEL_ORDER %>% select(parcel_name, group_label), by = "parcel_name") %>%
  left_join(parcel_info %>% distinct(parcel_name, section, section_num), by = "parcel_name") %>%
  mutate(group_label = ifelse(is.na(group_label), section, group_label),
         group_label = factor(group_label, levels = c("Auditory", "Cognitive", "Affective"))) %>%
  arrange(group_label, section_num, parcel_name) %>%
  mutate(pos = row_number())

plot_ymin_shared <- -4
plot_ymax_shared <- df_named %>%
  filter(contrast %in% c("real_vs_rest", "fake_vs_rest"),
         parcel_name %in% parcel_order_4$parcel_name) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(native_mean, native_se, l2_mean, l2_se),
               names_to = c("Group", ".value"), names_pattern = "(native|l2)_(mean|se)") %>%
  summarise(ymax = max(mean + se, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% pull(ymax) * 1.05

make_fig4_plot <- function(contrast_name, y_label) {
  sig_df <- df_named %>% filter(contrast == contrast_name, parcel_name %in% parcel_order_4$parcel_name)
  sig_long <- sig_df %>%
    select(parcel_name, t_stat, p_fdr, significant_fdr, native_mean, native_se, l2_mean, l2_se) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(native_mean, native_se, l2_mean, l2_se),
                 names_to = c("Group", ".value"), names_pattern = "(native|l2)_(mean|se)") %>%
    mutate(Group = recode(Group, native = "Native speakers", l2 = "L2 learners"),
           Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Native speakers", "L2 learners"))) %>%
    left_join(parcel_order_4, by = "parcel_name") %>%
    mutate(parcel_name = factor(parcel_name, levels = parcel_order_4$parcel_name))

  bracket_df <- parcel_order_4 %>%
    filter(parcel_name %in% PARCEL_ORDER$parcel_name) %>%
    group_by(group_label) %>%
    summarise(xmin = min(pos) - 0.4, xmax = max(pos) + 0.4, .groups = "drop")

  roi_barplot(sig_long, sig_df,
              parcel_label_df = parcel_order_4,
              bracket_df = bracket_df,
              y_label = y_label,
              group_colors = GROUP_COLORS_2,
              plot_ymin = plot_ymin_shared)
}

make_fig4_plot("real_vs_rest", bquote(paste("Average "* italic(t) * " (real words)")))
make_fig4_plot("fake_vs_rest", bquote(paste("Average "* italic(t) * " (pseudo words)")))
```

## Helper: 3-group plot with full bracket logic

```{r plot3group-fn}
plot_3group <- function(df, contrast_name, overlap_order, y_label,
                        plot_ymin = -4, group_colors = GROUP_COLORS_3) {
  sig_df <- df %>%
    filter(contrast == contrast_name,
           significant_fdr %in% c(TRUE, "True", "TRUE")) %>%
    left_join(parcel_info, by = c("parcel" = "parcel_num"))

  sig_long <- sig_df %>%
    select(parcel_name, section, section_num, f_stat,
           native_mean, native_se, l2_high_mean, l2_high_se,
           l2_low_mean, l2_low_se) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(native_mean, native_se, l2_high_mean, l2_high_se,
                          l2_low_mean, l2_low_se),
                 names_to = c("Group", ".value"),
                 names_pattern = "(native|l2_high|l2_low)_(mean|se)") %>%
    mutate(Group = recode(Group,
                          native  = "Native speakers",
                          l2_high = "Higher proficiency learners",
                          l2_low  = "Lower proficiency learners"),
           Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Native speakers",
                                            "Higher proficiency learners",
                                            "Lower proficiency learners"))) %>%
    left_join(overlap_order, by = "parcel_name") %>%
    mutate(is_overlap = !is.na(group_label)) %>%
    arrange(desc(is_overlap), overlap_pos, section_num, desc(abs(f_stat))) %>%
    mutate(parcel_name = factor(parcel_name, levels = unique(parcel_name)),
           group_label = factor(group_label, levels = c("Auditory", "Cognitive", "Affective")))

  parcel_pos <- tibble(parcel_name = levels(sig_long$parcel_name),
                       pos = seq_along(levels(sig_long$parcel_name)))
  sig_long <- sig_long %>% left_join(parcel_pos, by = "parcel_name")

  star_lookup <- sig_df %>%
    mutate(parcel_name = as.character(parcel_name),
           p_fdr = as.numeric(p_fdr),
           significant_fdr = significant_fdr %in% c(TRUE, "True", "TRUE")) %>%
    select(parcel_name, p_fdr, significant_fdr)

  star_df <- sig_long %>%
    mutate(parcel_name_chr = as.character(parcel_name)) %>%
    group_by(parcel_name, parcel_name_chr, group_label, pos) %>%
    summarise(y_top = max(mean + se, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(star_lookup, by = c("parcel_name_chr" = "parcel_name")) %>%
    mutate(stars = case_when(
      !significant_fdr ~ "",
      is.na(p_fdr)     ~ "*",
      p_fdr < 0.001    ~ "***",
      p_fdr < 0.01     ~ "**",
      TRUE             ~ "*"
    )) %>%
    filter(stars != "")

  bracket_df <- sig_long %>%
    filter(!is.na(group_label)) %>%
    distinct(parcel_name, group_label, pos) %>%
    group_by(group_label) %>%
    summarise(xmin = min(pos) - 0.4, xmax = max(pos) + 0.4, .groups = "drop")

  plot_ymax  <- max(c(sig_long$mean + sig_long$se, star_df$y_top), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15
  plot_range <- plot_ymax - plot_ymin

  parcel_label_y <- plot_ymin - 0.06 * plot_range
  bracket_y      <- plot_ymin - 0.32 * plot_range
  tick_len       <- 0.03 * plot_range
  label_y        <- bracket_y - 0.06 * plot_range
  star_gap       <- 0.03 * plot_range
  star_tick_len  <- 0.02 * plot_range

  star_bracket_df <- star_df %>%
    mutate(xmin = pos - DODGE_WIDTH * 0.4,
           xmax = pos + DODGE_WIDTH * 0.4,
           y_bracket = y_top + star_gap)

  ggplot(sig_long, aes(x = pos, y = mean, fill = Group)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = DODGE_WIDTH), width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
                  position = position_dodge(width = DODGE_WIDTH), width = 0.25) +
    geom_segment(data = star_bracket_df,
                 aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y_bracket, yend = y_bracket),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(data = star_bracket_df,
                 aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin, y = y_bracket, yend = y_bracket - star_tick_len),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(data = star_bracket_df,
                 aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax, y = y_bracket, yend = y_bracket - star_tick_len),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(data = star_bracket_df,
              aes(x = pos, y = y_bracket, label = stars),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 0, nudge_y = 0.01 * plot_range,
              size = FONT_PT / .pt) +
    geom_text(data = parcel_pos,
              aes(x = pos, y = parcel_label_y, label = parcel_name),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = FONT_PT / .pt, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1) +
    geom_segment(data = bracket_df,
                 aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = bracket_y, yend = bracket_y),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(data = bracket_df,
                 aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin, y = bracket_y, yend = bracket_y + tick_len),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(data = bracket_df,
                 aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax, y = bracket_y, yend = bracket_y + tick_len),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(data = bracket_df,
              aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = label_y, label = group_label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, fontface = "bold", size = FONT_PT / .pt, vjust = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off", ylim = c(plot_ymin, plot_ymax)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = FONT_PT) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 120, l = 10))
}
```

```{r figS2}
  "FOP5",   "Affective", 17
)

plot_3group(df_anova, "fake_vs_rest", PARCEL_ORDER_S2,
            y_label = bquote(paste("Average "* italic(t) * " (pseudo words)")),
            plot_ymin = -2)
```
